howitworks.title: 🎭 How the Standoff works
howitworks.step1Body: $20 to play. Buy in with any coin.
howitworks.step3Body: The most crowded door is out.
howitworks.step4Body: Survive and the pot is sent to your wallet automatically.
howitworks.potBody: every buy-in (any coin) converts to ROBINVAULT in the pot, a 6% rake comes out (half of it slips to a random Vault Robber every heist), and the last robber takes the rest. If the final crew all pick the same door, nobody wins and the pot rolls into the next game.
howitworks.fair: 🔒 Provably fair: the seed is locked in before each chamber and revealed after, so every round is replayable and voidable.
fairness.title: ⚖️ How outcomes are decided
fairness.point1: One random seed decides each heist.
fairness.point2: Its fingerprint is signed and published before buy-in opens, then committed on-chain before the first door, so the result cannot change once you are in.
fairness.point3: The seed is revealed after, so anyone can replay and verify it.
fairness.point4: Fresh seed every round, no rarity and no house picks.
fairness.point5: The only cut is a flat 6 percent rake, and half of it slips to a random Vault Robber every heist.
fairness.loading: Loading the locked seed for the open round...
fairness.seedPending: The seed fingerprint appears here the moment the next heist opens.
